Definition: Whether the instant payment system enables or plans to enable instant payments across national borders to other countries or regional payment systems, supporting remittances, trade, and regional integration.
Comments: Cross-border functionality exists at least partially through (a) WAEMU regional payment infrastructure (STAR-UEMOA RTGS supports participants including national public treasuries and banks across the union), and (b) international remittance reception into Wave wallets via partnerships (e.g., UBA Senegal/TerraPay/Wave enabling reception of international remittances to Wave e-wallets). ([BCEAO – STAR-UEMOA description](https://www.bceao.int/en/content/payment-systems-management);[TerraPay press release on Wave remittances to Senegal](https://www.terrapay.com/media/united-bank-of-africa-senegal-terrapay-and-wave-digital-finance-join-forces-to-enable-the-reception-of-international-remittance-transfers-enhance-financial-inclusion-in-senegal/))

Definition: Whether the system enables consumer payments to merchants and businesses for goods and services, including retail purchases, bill payments, e-commerce, and subscription services.
Comments: Merchant payments are supported by Senegal’s mobile money ecosystem: Orange Money explicitly supports “achat de biens et services dans les commerces”, and Wave’s licensed product roadmap includes merchant payments. ([Orange Money Senegal app description](https://apps.apple.com/au/app/orange-money-senegal/id1447224280);[Wave BCEAO e-money license announcement](https://www.wave.com/en/blog/sn-emi/))

Definition: Whether the instant payment system supports direct person-to-person transfer of funds between individuals for informal transactions, remittances, and interpersonal value transfers.
Comments: P2P transfers are a core use case via mobile money providers including Wave (peer-to-peer transfers; millions of active users in Senegal) and Orange Money (national/international transfers). ([Wave announcement of BCEAO e-money license & “largest mobile money provider in Senegal”](https://www.wave.com/en/blog/sn-emi/);[Orange Money Senegal app description](https://apps.apple.com/au/app/orange-money-senegal/id1447224280))

Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: BCEAO operates region-wide retail clearing (SICA-UEMOA) and RTGS (STAR-UEMOA) used by Senegal’s banks/treasury, and launched the Interoperable Instant Payment Platform (PI-SPI) for the WAEMU on 30 Sept 2025 enabling instant, irrevocable 24/7 transfers between banks, MFIs and electronic money issuers (a modern instant payment rail available in Senegal as a WAEMU member). ([BCEAO – Payment Systems Management](https://www.bceao.int/en/content/payment-systems-management);[Quidah – PI-SPI launch description](https://www.quidah.com/blog/instant-payments-platforms-in-west-africa))
